create_mcts_bot: create a MCTSBot that uses Monte-Carlo Tree Search to play a sequential game with terminal rewards
create_random_rollout_evaluator: create a RandomRolloutEvaluator that evaluates game states by averaging outcomes of random rollouts
run_mcts_search: run MCTS search from a given game state and return the most visited action
create_search_node: create a SearchNode representing a game state with UCT and PUCT selection values
test_mcts_with_evaluator: test MCTS bot with a custom evaluator to evaluate leaf nodes during tree search
